claim.statement: The native FalconCollector has exactly two collection flows, CollectAssets and CollectFindings; it has no alert, event, incident or detection flow.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: A YAML flow with no native counterpart would be compared against nothing.

evidence.summary: SupportedTopics lists only AssetsFlow and FindingsFlow; the class implements IAssetsAdapter and IFindingsAdapter only.

claim.statement: The native collector does not derive a base URL per cloud region: apiEndpoint comes from configuration (https:// prepended if missing), and the OAuth2 client-credentials token endpoint is apiEndpoint + /oauth2/token, handled by the Http.Package session.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: Region handling would be assumed native-side when it is actually caller-supplied.

evidence.summary: baseUrl read from ApiEndpoint/apiEndpoint/baseUrl/Host/Url keys; NormalizeBaseAddress prepends https://; SessionSpec Auth = OAuth2(ClientId, ClientSecret, TokenEndpoint = ApiEndpoint + /oauth2/token).

claim.statement: When no baseDate is supplied, both native flows still filter on a 365-day lookback: Discover gets last_seen_timestamp >= now-365d and Spotlight gets updated_timestamp >= now-365d.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: A YAML collector without that gate returns older hosts and findings, so the payloads differ by design, not by data.

evidence.summary: ResolveBaseDateUtcOrDefault returns now-365d for MinValue; the normalized date feeds the Discover last_seen gate filter and the Spotlight updated_timestamp floor.

claim.statement: Native assets call GET /discover/combined/hosts/v1?limit=1000&sort=last_seen_timestamp.asc&facet=risk_factors&facet=third_party&facet=system_insights plus filter= and after=, paginated by the meta.pagination.after cursor until after is empty.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: Endpoint, facet or sort differences between the two collectors would go unseen.

evidence.summary: BuildAssetsUrl pins limit, sort and three facets; the runner appends after=; AssetsApiPageSize defaults to 1000, clamped 1..1000.

claim.statement: With an explicit baseDate the native assets flow splits the window into newest-first calendar-month segments, each queried with last_seen_timestamp >= start and < end; the findings flow never segments.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: Query boundaries and record order differ from any unsegmented YAML scroll.

evidence.summary: UseMonthSegments = request.BaseDateUtc != MinValue; BuildNewestFirst walks month boundaries backwards; the findings spool uses only the gate filter.

claim.statement: The native assets payload is one NDJSON object per Discover page, key storageUrl-key-prefix/assets_NNNNNN.json, one line per Discover resource: the vendor host object verbatim plus an added device_policies property; UTF-8 without BOM, content type application/x-ndjson, no wrapper and no collector metadata inside the object.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: The parser input shape for assets would be assumed rather than known.

evidence.summary: Rows are re-parsed verbatim, enriched in place, serialized with ToJsonString and published via PublishAssetsUtf8PageAsync; the target is assets_NNNNNN.json prefixed with Metadata storageUrl; each record is followed by a newline.

claim.statement: The native findings flow is two-phase: Phase 1 spools the Discover inventory into storageUrl/_staging/gen_TICKS/hosts_NNNNNN.json and writes manifest.json; Phase 2 walks that frozen list in aid batches and runs one Spotlight scroll per batch.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: The YAML collector's single-pass shape would be compared to the wrong native structure.

evidence.summary: ResolveFrozenKeyListAsync spools, then Phase 2 enumerates FalconFrozenKeyList into the pump; staging keys are _staging/gen_(hex ticks)/hosts_%06d.json plus manifest.json.

claim.statement: In the findings flow, Discover hosts are keyed by a record key (aid, else device_id, else a 32-hex suffix of the combined id, else the combined id verbatim), deduplicated run-wide by that key, and hosts with none of these are dropped; the assets flow applies none of this and emits every resource.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: Host counts and host identity differ between assets and findings output, and against YAML.

evidence.summary: ExtractRecordKey precedence; keyless hosts are counted and skipped; SpoolKeyClaims.TryClaim collapses repeats and refuses colliding keys; the assets parser keeps every row.

claim.statement: Native Spotlight calls are GET /spotlight/combined/vulnerabilities/v1?limit=2500&facet=cve&facet=remediation&facet=evaluation_logic&sort=updated_timestamp.asc with filter suppression_info.is_suppressed:!'true' + status:['open','reopen','closed'] + aid:[sensor AIDs] + updated_timestamp:>=floor; one cursor scroll per aid batch of 8 hosts (default); only vendor-stated sensor AIDs go in the filter; a batch with no sensor AID makes no request.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: Filter, facet, status set or batch size mismatches would change which findings reach the parser.

evidence.summary: Base URL with three facets (evaluation_logic dropped when skipEvaluationLogicFacet is set); baseFilter literal; FindingsApiPageSize 2500; AidBatchSize 8; BuildBatchPlan indexes only hosts with a sensor AID.

claim.statement: Each native findings NDJSON line has properties aid, chunk, isLastChunk, findingsInChunk, host, findings: host is the Discover record plus device_policies; each finding is the Spotlight record with apps, suppression_info and host_info removed and remediation.entities sorted; at most 2000 findings per line; a host with zero findings still emits one line; findings are deduplicated by id and findings whose aid is not in the batch are dropped.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: The core per-record contract the parser reads for findings would be unknown.

evidence.summary: Build() writes the six properties; ShapeFinding strips three fields and sorts entities; chunk flush at the cap; the batch-end flush walks every host; orphan and seen-id skips.

claim.statement: Native findings publish one object per aid batch, named findings_NNNNNN.json from the host page counter (CurrentPage), in frozen-key-list order (staged page, then batch); BatchScopedStorage defaults to false, so objects land flat under the run's storageUrl.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: Object count, naming and ordering differences would be missed.

evidence.summary: outputPage = progressContext.CurrentPage; PublishFindingsUtf8PageAsync; BatchScopedStorage false; enumeration walks page keys, then Chunk(AidBatchSize).

claim.statement: Native hosts in both flows carry a collector-built device_policies envelope (schema_version 1, collection_status, prevention = assignment + definition_status + definition, or null), built from POST /devices/entities/devices/v2 (JSON body with an ids array, one call per Discover page or staged page, bisected on unattributed refusals) and GET /policy/entities/prevention/v1?ids=.. (100 ids per call); only the findings flow also calls GET /policy/combined/prevention/v1?limit=5000&offset=0.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: The policy join is a native-only enrichment the YAML side must reproduce, or the host objects differ.

evidence.summary: Envelope builder; device POST body writer; definition chunk of 100; the only production caller of the sweep is FalconHostSpooler.RunPolicyStageAsync (Roslyn find_callers).

claim.statement: EnablePreventionPolicyEnrichment defaults to false in the committed dev source; the uncommitted working-tree change sets it to true; when false no policy endpoint is called and every host still gets device_policies with collection_status disabled and prevention null.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: The native payload differs depending on which build runs; comparing against the wrong one misattributes a divergence.

evidence.summary: The diff shows the default changed from false to true in the working tree; the disabled path attaches the Disabled() envelope.

claim.statement: Native response unwrapping reads only resources[], meta.pagination.after and meta.pagination.total from Discover, Spotlight and prevention responses; an errors[] array on a 2xx response is ignored. Only the device-entities client reads errors[].id.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: Vendor partial errors reported in errors[] silently change the native payload.

evidence.summary: The stream reader handles only the target array and meta; other top-level properties stream through; the device client parses resources and errors in one pass.

claim.statement: Native HTTP resilience: session retry of 3 attempts, exponential with jitter from 2s; server-suggested delays up to 60s are slept in-process and longer ones externalized; token bucket 35/50/queue 60; circuit breaker 3 failures, 300s; 5 min timeout; a 404 on an after= URL becomes a cursor-expired condition that re-anchors from the watermark; 401 and 5xx become host-scheduled recoveries.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: Throughput and failure-recovery differences between the collectors would be missed.

evidence.summary: Typed defaults; CreateTransient values; cursor-expiry classification; RecoverAndRetry and RequestDeferredRecovery branches.

claim.statement: In the native assets flow a Discover page whose rows are all filtered out (month-segment window or watermark boundary dedupe) ends that segment's scroll even when an after token is still present, and a failed policy assignment lookup (401/403/429/5xx) throws before publish, so that page writes no object.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: Silent truncation or missing assets objects would be attributed to the vendor instead of to native control flow.

evidence.summary: The RecordCount == 0 branch returns true (segment done) without checking AfterToken; EnrichAsync runs before PublishAssetsUtf8PageAsync; MustPropagate statuses throw.

claim.statement: In native findings a batch is published whole or not at all: a failed or interrupted Spotlight scroll discards the batch's partial accumulators, publishes nothing for it, and the resume replays from the checkpoint's staged-page and batch-index position under the same object name.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: Partial findings objects would be assumed possible natively when they are not.

evidence.summary: Publish and checkpoint happen in one step; cancellation and transport failures rethrow after recording; the pump materialises a batch before handing it over.

claim.statement: Native findings Phase 1 follows empty Discover pages that still carry an after token for up to 5 in a row; past that it stops, records the freeze as degraded, and Phase 2 still publishes the truncated inventory.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: A truncated native host set would be read as a vendor difference.

evidence.summary: MaxConsecutiveEmptyLivePages = 5; scrollTruncated is recorded in SpooledFreeze; the code comment states no caller gates on Freeze.State.

claim.statement: Native FQL arrives from the RUN payload action.filter or metadata filter/fql, is validated by FQLParser, and is prepended to the Discover filter in both flows; it is never applied to the Spotlight query.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: A YAML collector that applies FQL to vulnerabilities would scope findings differently.

evidence.summary: Filter extraction; FQLParser().Parse; ParsedFqlFilter only enters BuildLastSeenTimestampGateFilter; the Spotlight baseFilter has no user term.

claim.statement: Native dry-run issues a single request with limit=1 (assets: Discover; findings: a Discover probe) and publishes nothing.
claim.consequenceIfWrong: Dry-run output would be compared as if it were a collection.

evidence.summary: limit is forced to 1; DryRunValidated returns 0; findings returns after FetchPageAsync.
